summary: This bill designates the United States Postal Service facility located at 2407 State Route 71, Suite 1, in Spring Lake, New Jersey, as the "James J. Howard Post Office".

scores.thoughts: This bill is solely about renaming a post office and does not involve any appropriations or changes to government spending. The administrative cost of changing a sign would be negligible and not central to the bill's purpose.
The bill concerns the designation of a postal facility and has no relation to voting access, election reform, voter ID, or election security.
